# awscc_identitystore_user (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::IdentityStore::User



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (Attributes List) A list of addresses associated with the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addresses))
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the user.
- `birthdate` (String) The user's birthdate in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time the user was created.
- `created_by` (String) The identifier of the user or system that created the user.
- `display_name` (String) A string containing the name of the user for display.
- `emails` (Attributes List) A list of email addresses associated with the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--emails))
- `identity_store_id` (String) The globally unique identifier for the identity store.
- `locale` (String) The geographical region or location of the user.
- `name` (Attributes) The name of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name))
- `nick_name` (String) An alternate name for the user.
- `phone_numbers` (Attributes List) A list of phone numbers associated with the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_numbers))
- `photos` (Attributes List) A list of photos associated with the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--photos))
- `preferred_language` (String) The preferred language of the user.
- `profile_url` (String) A URL associated with the user.
- `roles` (Attributes List) A list of roles associated with the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `timezone` (String) The time zone for the user.
- `title` (String) The title of the user.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time the user was last updated.
- `updated_by` (String) The identifier of the user or system that last updated the user.
- `user_id` (String) The identifier for a user in the identity store.
- `user_name` (String) A unique string used to identify the user.
- `user_status` (String) The current status of the user account.
- `user_type` (String) A string indicating the type of user.
- `website` (String) The user's personal website or blog URL.
